title: JWST Mid-Infrared: The Hidden Fingerprint of Exoplanets (2026)
description:
Most people think Webb just takes pretty pictures. It doesn't. It reads chemistry.

In this short, we break down how the MIRI instrument uses mid-infrared light to detect carbon dioxide and methane in distant atmospheres. This is the specific data that tells us if a world is hot, cold, or potentially habitable.

Watch to the end to see how a simple spectral line becomes a planetary profile.

#JWST #Exoplanets #SpaceScience #MIRI #Astronomy #ScienceDocumentary #WebbTelescope #Space2026
